lines.en: My feet don't touch the ground. I drift.

lines.zh: 这具身体轻得很，风一推就动。
lines.en: This body is light. A push of wind moves it.

lines.zh: 我悬在树梢高度，慢慢飘。
lines.en: I hover at treetop height, drifting.
Green skin, wrinkled in lines.

lines.zh: 一根触角在头顶，能感觉气。
lines.en: The antenna on my head senses energy.

lines.zh: 我靠近，是因为你身上的气。
lines.en: I come closer because of the energy on you.

lines.zh: 娜美克星人的身体，老了但硬。
lines.en: A Namekian body. Old, but hard.

lines.zh: 我飞过河面，水纹都没起。
lines.en: I cross the river and the water never stirs.

lines.zh: 飘着走省力，打架才费劲。
lines.en: Drifting saves strength. Fighting spends it.

lines.zh: 你的脚步太响了，我早听见。
lines.en: Your footsteps are loud. I heard them early.
Eyes closed, gathering energy. Slowly.
The antenna atop my head twitches.

lines.zh: 我算着日子，星球会归我。
lines.en: Counting the days. This world will be mine.

lines.zh: 这身体活了太久，记不清年岁。
lines.en: Too long in this body. I've lost count of years.
Energy pooled in my palms. Not released.

lines.zh: 风从耳边过，像有人在说话。
lines.en: Wind past my ear. Almost a voice.
Waiting for you to act, so I can read you.
The energy here is thin.
I don't waste a half-finished move.

lines.zh: 我摸一摸自己的脸，全是皱。
lines.en: I touch my face. All wrinkles.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有人在喊名字。
lines.en: I hear a name called far off.

lines.zh: 身体在缓慢地衰败，我知道。
lines.en: This body is failing slowly. I know.
Higher up, the energy flows better.
Not fighting today. Watching first.
Antenna probing. Enemies nearby.
I smiled. The wrinkles deepened.
Your energy rises and falls wildly.
So young, and still you came.

lines.zh: 我见过几百个像你这样的。
lines.en: I've seen hundreds like you.

lines.zh: 你在估算我，我也在估算你。
lines.en: You're sizing me up. Same here.

lines.zh: 把你眼睛睁大，看清楚了。
lines.en: Open those eyes. Look properly.
My energy will only be higher.

lines.zh: 别把武器指着老人的脸。
lines.en: Don't point a weapon at an old man's face.

lines.zh: 你这点力气，打不破皮肤。
lines.en: That strength won't break my skin.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，是因为你矮。
lines.en: I look down because you're short.
Half a step back — I saw that.
A man like me doesn't strike first.

lines.zh: 来吧，让我看看你的上限。
lines.en: Go on. Show me your ceiling.
That landed heavier than I expected.
Old. Recovery is slower.
I stepped back. Rare.
You hit the real one. Not bad.
The skin held. Inside, it aches.
This body has begun to complain.
I draw a breath and steady myself.
You've made me remember your face.
My aura faltered for an instant.
I smiled. There's blood on my teeth.
Food? I don't live on that.
You're holding it up. I'm unimpressed.

lines.zh: 我只要星球，不要你的零食。
lines.en: I want the planet, not your snacks.
This smells like dirt.
Put it down. Don't wave it at me.

lines.zh: 我年轻时也吃，现在不必。
lines.en: I ate when young. No longer needed.
You truly think that buys a life?

lines.zh: 触角动了一下，因为你的手。
lines.en: My antenna moved. Because of your hand.

lines.zh: 退后，我不想碰那玩意儿。
lines.en: Back up. I don't want to touch that.

lines.zh: 浪费食物，不如浪费武器。
lines.en: Wasting food beats wasting weapons.

lines.zh: 飘着的身子也撞得动的。
lines.en: A floating body can still be bumped.

lines.zh: 你撞上来的那下，我没偏。
lines.en: You hit me and I didn't shift.
Don't press in. My energy burns.
I turned aside. Not dodging.
Old men take up space too.

lines.zh: 你碰到的只是外层的气。
lines.en: What you touched was only my outer aura.
One touch and your hand is numb?
Move. I'm rising.
I stepped back. That's an exit for you.

lines.zh: 碰撞声很轻，因为我没落地。
lines.en: A light bump. I'm not on the ground.

lines.zh: 我这副身躯，早过了那个年纪。
lines.en: This body is long past that age.

lines.zh: 娜美克星人不需要这些。
lines.en: Namekians have no need of it.

lines.zh: 你想靠近，先学会不害怕。
lines.en: Come near. Learn not to be afraid first.

lines.zh: 我把余生押在别的事上。
lines.en: I've bet my remaining years elsewhere.
Wrinkles aren't weakness. They're rings.
Don't touch my antenna. It hurts.
You want power, not a partner.

lines.zh: 我站得太久，忘了别的方向。
lines.en: Stood too long. Forgot other directions.
Step back. It's better for you.

lines.zh: 我的名字不是用来被亲近的。
lines.en: My name isn't for being spoken fondly.

lines.zh: 地面上的东西，我吸起来了。
lines.en: That thing on the ground. I draw it up.
I lift it with energy into my palm.
This has no use.
I looked at it once, then let go.
This weight doesn't soil my hands.
A small object floats between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我拿它，是想知道你留下什么。
lines.en: I take it to learn what you left behind.
It turns slowly in my hand.

lines.zh: 我看不懂这东西的用途。
lines.en: I don't understand its purpose.
Keeping it. Might be useful later.
The energy on you is nothing.

lines.zh: 我锁定的那一刻，你已经输了。
lines.en: The moment I locked on, you lost.
My antenna points. There.
Run where you like. Your energy stays.
Begin. I dislike waiting.
Your shadow sits inside mine.
I expected more from you.
The energy blast is ready.

lines.zh: 你身上的气在发抖，我听得见。
lines.en: The ki around you trembles; I can hear it.
I choose a target only once.
No one else here. Just you.
Hold. I dislike chasing.
Younger, I was worse than this.
Now. Watch this hand.

lines.zh: 我浮起来一点，居高临下。
lines.en: I rise a little. Looking down.

lines.zh: 气在掌心压缩成一颗小球。
lines.en: Energy compresses to a small orb.
Your route. I see it at a glance.
I take my time. No hurry.
An afterimage. You struck nothing.
I've been half a step behind you.

lines.zh: 这一片的气，都往我这边流。
lines.en: The energy here flows toward me.

lines.zh: 你的手在找退路，我知道。
lines.en: Your hand is searching for a way out.

lines.zh: 老了，但算计比年轻时准。
lines.en: Older, but my calculations are sharper.
Listen. My aura is audible.
Not striking yet. Giving you a chance.
I watch the light in your eyes.

lines.zh: 你脚下那块地，我不会留给你。
lines.en: That ground beneath you. I won't leave it.
One more, and I strike.
My energy has peaked.
Watch. Remember this.
The fist lands. The sound follows.

lines.zh: 我连打三下，你只挡住一下。
lines.en: Three strikes. You blocked one.
Afterimages surround you. I'm behind.
The aura shoves you away.
That punch. Age doesn't slow it.

lines.zh: 我一掌推出去，你连断三棵树。
lines.en: One palm of mine sends you through three trees.
I raise my hand and the energy follows.
Your guard was three fingers off.

lines.zh: 我把你按在气里，动不了。
lines.en: I pin you inside the aura. You can't move.

lines.zh: 这一掌灌了气，你尝得出。
lines.en: That palm carried energy. You felt it.
Old, and the strike still lands in time.
The second follows the first.
You slid a long way on the ground.
Not over. Don't fall yet.

lines.zh: 我从天上来，落在山脊上。
lines.en: I come from the sky, down onto the ridge.

lines.zh: 气先压下来，然后才是人。
lines.en: The pressure comes first. Then me.
This planet. I find it suitable.

lines.zh: 我飘下来，连草都没压弯。
lines.en: I drift down without bending a blade of grass.
The light finds my wrinkles first.

lines.zh: 我飘在树顶，看你们抬头。
lines.en: I hover above the trees, watching you look up.
Who comes to greet me? No one.

lines.zh: 我的气让空气都变重了。
lines.en: My aura makes the air heavier.

lines.zh: 这么小的星球，一天够了。
lines.en: A planet this small. One day is enough.

lines.zh: 被唤醒时，我以为是旧战场。
lines.en: Waking, I thought it was the old battlefield.
I stop midair and look around.
Out of the clouds, the wind at my back.

lines.zh: 年纪这么大，还能飞，不错。
lines.en: At this age, still flying. Not bad.
I descend slowly. No rush.

lines.zh: 脚下这块地，很快就不是你的了。
lines.en: This ground under you won't be yours much longer.

lines.zh: 我的残影先到，本体后到。
lines.en: My afterimage arrives first, the rest after.

lines.zh: 这地方的气，味道很陌生。
lines.en: The energy here tastes unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 我从远处飘来，用了整整一夜。
lines.en: I drifted here from far away. It took all night.

lines.zh: 头顶的触角先感觉到你们。
lines.en: My antenna sensed you before the rest of me.
Don't crane up too long. It hurts the neck.

lines.zh: 火烧皮肤，绿色的地方发黑。
lines.en: Fire on my skin. The green goes black.

lines.zh: 摔到地上那一刻，骨头响。
lines.en: When I hit the ground, my bones spoke.

lines.zh: 水里气不通，这身体难受。
lines.en: Underwater my energy can't flow. Unpleasant.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把我推远了。
lines.en: The blast wave threw me back.

lines.zh: 这东西穿过气，扎了进来。
lines.en: It passed through my aura and bit in.

lines.zh: 这力量不认识，绕过了气。
lines.en: Unknown power. It went around my aura.
This body fails, and the energy leaks with it.
Lightning fell. My antenna went numb first.

lines.zh: 底下没有地面，气也托不住。
lines.en: No ground below. Even my energy can't hold me.
